scripts.translation: 我可是技藝最精湛的鐵匠！

scripts.text: I am the best Armsmith ever!
scripts.translation: 我是有史以來最厲害的武器匠！

scripts.text: I don't refine normal, boring items.
scripts.translation: 我不精煉普通又無聊的裝備。

scripts.text: I only refine items that are Level 10 or higher.
scripts.translation: 我只精煉等級10以上的裝備。

scripts.text: Anyway, you may use my services if your item is Level 10 or higher.
scripts.translation: 總之，只要裝備等級達到10以上，就可以來找我。

scripts.text: What do you want me to refine?
I don't think I can refine any items you have...
scripts.translation: 我想你身上沒有能讓我精煉的裝備...

scripts.text: I said I don't work with items that are lower than Level 10.
scripts.translation: 我說過，我不處理等級低於10的裝備。

scripts.text: If you want to refine this {0},
Are you sure you want to continue?
Hm... if you mind... never mind...
scripts.translation: 嗯...如果你介意的話...算了...

scripts.text: This {0} already has been refined several times.
scripts.translation: 這件{0}已經精煉過好幾次了。

scripts.text: It could be destroyed if I try again.
It won't break for sure, but there is has a small chance.
scripts.translation: 雖然不一定會壞，但還是有一定風險。

scripts.text: You could be ^FF0000lowering the upgrade level^000000 of the {0},
scripts.translation: 你可能會降低^FF0000精煉等級^000000{0}，

scripts.text: or if it breaks, you will lose ^FF0000any cards^000000 or special properties added to it.
scripts.translation: 如果裝備損壞，^FF0000卡片^000000和附加屬性也會全部消失。

scripts.text: Do you still want me to refine it?
I think I have given you enough warning.
scripts.translation: 我想我已經提醒得夠多了。

scripts.text: Well, no challenge is one way to go...
scripts.translation: 好吧，不接受挑戰也是一種選擇...

scripts.text: No risk... that could be wise.
scripts.translation: 沒有風險...也許這樣更明智。

scripts.text: Hm. You don't seem to have enough money or {0}.
Please come back when you have them.
You switched the item while I wasn't looking! Get out of here!
scripts.translation: 趁我沒注意偷偷換了裝備！快滾出去！
我可是最厲害的武器匠。

scripts.text: Oh my! I've failed to refine stuff...
I could have made a mistake even though I am the best Armsmith ever.
scripts.translation: 就算我是最厲害的武器匠，也可能會出錯。

scripts.text: It just wasn't meant to be.
I will do a better job next time! Don't worry!
scripts.translation: 下次我會做得更好！別擔心！

scripts.text: I can refine this to the safe limit or a desired number of times. It's your choice.
scripts.translation: 我可以把這件裝備精煉到安全上限，或者按指定次數精煉。由你決定。

scripts.text: How many times would you like me to refine your item?
I can't refine this item that many times.
scripts.translation: 我不能把這件裝備精煉這麼多次。

scripts.text: This will try to refine the equipment {0} times past the safe limit. Your equipment may be destroyed... is that ok?
scripts.translation: 這將嘗試把裝備超過安全上限精煉{0}次。裝備可能會損壞...確定嗎？

scripts.text: You said so... So be it.
scripts.translation: 這是你自己說的...那就開始吧。

scripts.text: You said so... So be it.
scripts.translation: 這是你自己說的...那就開始吧。

scripts.text: That will cost you {0} {1} and {2} Zeny. Is that ok?
scripts.translation: 這需要{0}個{1}和{2} Zeny。可以嗎？

scripts.text: You said so... So be it.
scripts.translation: 這是你自己說的...那就開始吧。

scripts.text: Hm. You don't seem to have enough money or {0}.
Please come back when you have them.
Look here... you don't have any items on...
scripts.translation: 喂...你身上什麼裝備都沒穿...

scripts.text: Clang... No, but did you imagine I could be so stupid?!
scripts.translation: 鐺...等等，你以為我會這麼傻嗎？！

scripts.text: Get out before I stun you with my Hammer!!
scripts.translation: 趁我用錘子把你敲暈前快滾！！

scripts.text: Oh my! I've failed to refine stuff...
I could have made a mistake even though I am the best Armsmith ever.
scripts.translation: 就算我是最厲害的武器匠，也可能會出錯。

scripts.text: It just wasn't meant to be.
I will do a better job next time! Don't worry!

scripts.text: I can exchange it for some Carnium.
scripts.translation: 我可以幫你換成卡尼姆。

scripts.text: Take it and use it well.
My cool dad Holink said I have the world's greatest refine hammer!!
scripts.translation: 我帥氣的爸爸霍林克說，我有世界上最棒的精煉錘！！

scripts.text: Who do you think I am?
Yes!!! You!! You want to refine?
Dad said. There's no cure for stupidity...
scripts.translation: 爸爸說過，愚蠢是沒救的...

scripts.text: What an arrogant left hand this is!
What an arrogant right hand this is!
Get that dirty thing off my face!!
scripts.translation: 把那髒東西從我臉上拿開！！

scripts.text: Are you talking about the other head part?
scripts.translation: 你說的是另一個頭部裝備嗎？

scripts.text: Perfect refining. Did I do this for you?
scripts.translation: 完美精煉。是我替你做的嗎？

scripts.text: Hmm, an armor refine? Someone like you?
You need ^ff9999{0}^000000 and ^ff9999{1}^000000 Zeny. Do you have them?
I knew you were not worth trying my magical refining hammer for.
scripts.translation: 我就知道你不配讓我用魔法精煉錘為你精煉。

scripts.text: This {0} has been refined quite a bit, huh?
scripts.translation: 這件{0}已經精煉過不少次了吧？

scripts.text: You do know that this might break, right?
scripts.translation: 你知道它可能會損壞吧？

scripts.text: If you break the {0}, you can never use it again.
scripts.translation: 如果{0}損壞了，就再也不能使用。

scripts.text: You can't even take this big step. Don't think about refining...
scripts.translation: 連這點魄力都沒有，就別想精煉了...

scripts.text: Hey you!! Didn't I tell you
You switched the item while I wasn't looking! Get out of here!
scripts.translation: 趁我沒注意偷偷換了裝備！快滾出去！

scripts.text: Arrgg~ It's all~ Broken...? What a pity~
How can my hammer fail from refining?
scripts.translation: 我的錘子怎麼會精煉失敗？
沒有什麼是我不能精煉的

scripts.text: We sell and exchange various ores used in smelting.
scripts.translation: 我們出售並兌換各種用於精煉的礦石。

scripts.text: Phracon and Emveretarcon are available for use in smelting low-level weapons.
scripts.translation: 鐵礦石和鋼鐵可用於精煉低等級武器。

scripts.text: We are purifying Elunium Stone or Oridecon Stone, or exchanging them with Bradium or Carnium.
scripts.translation: 我們可以精煉鋁原石或神之金屬原石，也能將它們兌換成布拉迪姆或卡尼姆。

scripts.text: We add Etel Dust to existing smelting ores and replace them with Ether-bearing smelting ores.
scripts.translation: 我們還能在現有精煉礦石中加入以太粉末，將其換成含以太的精煉礦石。

scripts.text: If you lack the materials used for smelting, come anytime.
scripts.translation: 如果缺少精煉材料，隨時歡迎來找我們。

scripts.text: We will exchange them for refined products for use as smelting goods.
scripts.translation: 我們可以把它們兌換成精煉用的加工品。
